results.title: Cellectis Presents Preclinical Data Highlighting Efficient APOC3 Editing and Marked Triglyceride Reduction with .HEAL-101 at ESGCT 2026
results.description: NEW YORK, Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Cellectis (Euronext Growth: ALCLS – Nasdaq: CLLS), a genome engineering company developing genetic medicines for diseases that today demand a lifetime of treatment, today announced the presentation of preclinical data supporting .HEAL-101, its in vivo base editing product candidate targeting APOC3 for severe hypertriglyceridemia (sHTG), at the Annual Congress of the European Society of Gene and Cell Therapy (ESGCT), being held October 27-30, 2026, in
